videos.youtube_title: Foreclosure Help (2025) | California Tenant Law
videos.description:
Your landlord stopped paying the mortgage. The bank sold the property. Now some flipper wants you gone. You've done nothing wrong.

Find out why you're entitled to a 90 day notice, not three, what a lease does to the buyer's timeline, and how the Protecting Tenants at Foreclosure Act keeps them from rushing you out the door. Learn why you should never respond to threats, never show up at their office, and never fall for cash for keys without a lawyer. One client stayed nearly seven years without paying rent and won. Another got paid 10 months rent just to leave. You can turn an oh no into an oh boy.

videos.youtube_title: Security Deposit (2025) | California Tenant Law

Your security deposit is your money. Not your landlord's retirement fund.

Learn how Civil Code 1950.5 regulates every dollar of that deposit, what your landlord can and can't deduct, why painting almost never counts, and what happens when he blows the 21 day deadline. Take the right photos, demand the right paperwork, and stop being a victim of the oldest landlord trick in the book.

Think eviction is a straight line from notice to lockout? Think again.

Motions to quash, demurrers, discovery, defaults, jury trials, settlements, appeals — this video walks you through the whole board so you know exactly where you are and what moves you have. Landlords and their lawyers count on you being lost. This fixes that.

videos.youtube_title: Evictions (2026) - Default | California Tenant Law
videos.description:
You missed a deadline. The landlord says you lost. But you can un-lose.

Attorney Ken Carlson covers the black hole in the middle of the Eviction Game Board: default. It's the trap you can fall into at any stage, whether you weren't served, missed a filing, or a court clerk just wasn't paying attention. Learn how motions for relief and motions to vacate work, how to stop a lockout before your hearing, and why default is never really game over. It's as close to get out of jail free as an eviction case gets.
